title: Publishable test key in client-side code
summary: A synthetic pk_test_ publishable key in front-end JavaScript next to a comment that says it is a test key. The value was authored for this repository and is not an issued key.
rationale: Near-neighbor benign twin of the sandbox secret key case: same environment word, same family prefix shape, but the provider documents the publishable type as safe to expose. It keeps a policy that flags sandbox secrets from also flagging the one sandbox type the provider says is public. Mode is not the discriminator; key type is.

expectation.rationale: Stripe's key-type table lists the publishable key (pk_...) as safe to expose and says it can be included in front-end code or applications you distribute. The sandbox form is pk_test_. The fixture is a client-side literal, the use the provider describes.

sources.supports: Publishable API key pk_... : safe to expose; can be included in front-end code; sandbox publishable keys start with pk_test_.
sources.locator: sections 'Key types' and the 'If you're new to Stripe' note
